colleges.notes: CORRECTED ENTRY: replaces the round-1 entry (which had only the All India / General Merit table from the 2-page extract) — same Mgmt figures, plus the NRI/PIO/FN table and hostel from the full brochure. Section 5(a): 'annual fees payable by the candidate admitted to the constituent Colleges of SSAHE viz., Sri Siddhartha Medical College & Hospital, Tumkur, ... and Sri Siddhartha Institute of Medical Sciences & Research Centre, T-Begur for the academic year 2026-27'; the MD/MS tables name both colleges. NRI tuition is printed '1,00,000,00/-' and '1,50,000,00/-' (non-standard comma grouping; digits = 10000000 and 15000000, i.e. ₹1 crore / ₹1.5 crore per annum, in rupees not USD). Hostel deposit and boarding are paid to a separate account; period of the hostel charge not stated.
